Every command the old, thick CLI (`internal/cli`, no longer a release asset as of the Phase 5 switch -- see `make keyorix-legacy` for the rollback build) supported, and where it lives now: the new thin CLI (`keyorix ...`), a host-side `keyorix-server admin ...` command, a separate tool, or removed outright. Generated directly from the same `commandCensus` map that [`docs/cli-split-inventory-census.md`](cli-split-inventory-census.md) is generated from, so this table cannot drift from that census -- `internal/cli/cli_migration_doc_test.go`'s `TestCLIMigrationDoc` fails the build otherwise.
